Day-to-day operations and extraordinary transactions

The Circosta Law Firm offers comprehensive services in corporate and commercial law, guiding companies in their day-to-day operations as well as in extraordinary transactions. We assist businesses in:

  • governance;
  • corporate restructuring;
  • mergers and acquisitions;
  • the management of shareholder relations.

We always ensure transparency and compliance with both local and international regulations.

Commercial contracts, partnerships and joint ventures

Our firm supports entrepreneurs and corporations in drafting and negotiating contracts that regulate commercial activities, partnerships and joint ventures. We are committed to providing solutions that are not only legally sound but also aligned with the strategic objectives of our clients.

Cross-border operations

Thanks to our international network, we are able to accompany companies operating across borders, ensuring that business operations are structured in a way that minimizes risks and maximizes opportunities.

From compliance to litigation, our approach is practical, reliable and oriented toward long-term success.
